From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC traffic-light plan & kickoff proposal

Hi Claire / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a concrete POC proposal so we can get to an actionable kickoff:

Summary of goals (as discussed)
- Prove integration of Redwood inference into Aurelia’s customer support search pipeline.
- Meet latency & cost targets while maintaining answer relevance for top-3 intents.

Success criteria (scored pass/fail and traffic-light gate each week)
- Latency: p95 end-to-end inference < 200ms on representative traffic (green) / 200–350ms (amber) / >350ms (red)
- Quality: Top-3 answer relevance >= 85% (green) / 70–85% (amber) / <70% (red)
- Throughput: 50 reqs/s sustained per instance (green) / 30–50 (amber) / <30 (red)
- Cost target: unit inference cost <= $0.002/token (green) / $0.002–$0.004 (amber) / >$0.004 (red)

Proposed timeline & milestones
- Kickoff: Thu May 24 — 60-min cross-functional session (integration owners, security, infra)
- Week 1 (May 27): Data handoff & sandbox access; infra validation (Jonas)
- Week 2 (Jun 3): Baseline eval & prompt set run (Karthik)
- Week 3 (Jun 10): Optimization pass (batching/quantization) and cost readout (Marissa)
- Final readout: Wed Jun 21 — full findings, recommended next steps

Cadence and gates
- Weekly 30-min check-ins on Thursdays, traffic-light status update each call.
- Decision gates: if any criterion is Red for two consecutive check-ins, we pause feature rollout and escalate.

Owners (proposed)
- Program lead / external coordination: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood)
- Infra / private deployment validation: Jonas Weber (Redwood)
- Evaluation scenarios & metrics: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Onboarding & success metrics: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Aurelia technical lead: Raj Patel

Next steps I need from Aurelia by EOD Tue May 21
1) Confirm kickoff attendees and preferred timezone for weekly checks (we suggested Thursdays 10am PT).
2) Provide sample dataset access instructions for sandbox (S3 or secure FTP).
3) Any non-standard compliance requirements (e.g., additional logging retention or IP allowlists).

Attachments: I’ll share a short SOW and an eval checklist before the kickoff.

Thanks — I’ll pencil in May 24 for the kickoff unless you want a different date.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Looping you in with the finalized kickoff date (Tue May 29, 10:00am PT). Please review the short checklist below and reply with any blockers by EOD Mon May 21 so we can be ready. I’m copying the attachments we shared with the customer for reference.

Pre-kickoff checklist (owners in parenthesis)

- Audit log retention & delivery (Jonas) — confirm we can surface request logs and retention window to Aurelia; propose 30 days by default.
- Eval scenario templates (Karthik) — assemble the top-10 prompt set and expected labels for the initial run.
- Baseline run automation (Marissa) — prepare the runner and dashboards for cost/latency per-campaign.
- Calendar invite + agenda (Vanessa) — I’ll send after you confirm owners.

Traffic-light gating: I’ll maintain a shared sheet with the weekly green/amber/red statuses and a short note column for mitigations. If any metric hits Red for two weeks we’ll schedule an immediate deep-dive.

Short replies below — will pull these into the kickoff invite: 
> Jonas Weber: I’ll validate S3 creds once Claire shares them; 30-day logs is fine — will add a checkbox for IP allowlist.
> Marissa Cole: I’ll wire up the baseline runner and dashboard by EOD Mon.
> Karthik Iyer: I’ll draft the prompt set and expected label schema; ETA Tue May 22.

Thanks — let me know if any of you see high-risk items to address before the kickoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
